scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C apps/web dev" "API_PORT=8080 pnpm -C apps/api dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C apps/web preview" "API_PORT=8080 pnpm -C apps/api start"
scripts.build: pnpm -C apps/web build && pnpm -C apps/api build
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && pnpm prisma migrate deploy
